title: Mahogany Desk
description: A fine example of a Victorian mahogany desk with original leather top.
fullDescription: This exceptional mahogany writing desk dates from the mid-Victorian period. It features its original inset leather writing surface with blind and gold tooling. The mahogany is of a rich, warm colour and the piece stands on its original porcelain castors.
provenance: Sourced from a private estate in Norfolk.
